narration:1:1710350202:0.text: The magic armor spots you. An iron hand clamps down on your shoulder... Before long, you are back where you started.
narration:1:1710350202:0.source_cn: 魔法盔甲发现了你们的踪迹，一只铁手死死钳住了你的肩膀…...
narration:1:1710350202:0.male: The magic armor spots you. An iron hand clamps down on your shoulder... Before long, you are back where you started.

narration:3:1710350203:0.text: A magic armor hears your footsteps and charges toward you in fury... In the nick of time, you find yourselves back where you started.
narration:3:1710350203:0.source_cn: 你们的脚步声惊动了魔法盔甲，它怒气冲冲地向你们走来……...

narration:4:1710350201:0.text: You run head-on into a patrolling magic armor. The moment its icy gaze locks onto you, you find yourselves back where you started.
narration:4:1710350201:0.source_cn: 你们迎面碰上了巡逻的魔法盔甲，它冰冷的眼光注视着你们…...
